Military tiers / Early game

MT0 → MT1: Build your first working tower

Develop a dependable combat blueprint, unlock more regions, and earn your first Headquarters promotion.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Early game

MT1 → MT2: Build an economy that supports your tower

Make Workshop upgrades affordable while collecting enough modules and regions for MT2.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Early game

MT2 → MT3: Expand your module collection

Use regions, challenges and experiments to prepare for MT3 without spending everything on one expensive attack.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Early game

MT3 → MT4: Prepare for Facility AI

Complete the last pre-AI promotion and identify the repetitive tasks you want to automate at MT4.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Early game

MT4 → MT5: Finish the module grind for Wave Momentum

Collect and maximize enough modules to reach MT5 while your production handles the cost.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Endless progression

MT5 → MT6: Understand total module tier

Expand your collection and upgrade module tiers across it to reach MT6.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Endless progression

MT6 → MT7: Push Endless to one million waves

Build a fast, sustainable Endless run and reach the documented wave milestone for MT7.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Endless progression

MT7 → MT8: Turn wave acceleration into Era access

Reach wave 100 billion and unlock MT8’s Era tools.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Era progression

MT8 → MT9: Learn Era shields and elemental powers

Build a tower that can handle the first Eras and work toward Era 5 for MT9.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Era progression

MT9 → MT10: Make Era divisors affordable

Develop an XP-and-divisor loop that can carry you toward Era 1,000.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Era progression

MT10 → MT11: Make the Neutral Stone discovery

Reach Era 10 million and complete the separate discovery associated with the Neutral Infinity Stone.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Era progression

MT11 → MT12: Prepare the journey to Infinity

Use broader Era records and acceleration to reach Era 100 billion, the documented boundary for Infinity 1.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Infinity progression

MT12 → MT13: Build your first Infinity-capable tower

Learn Infinity combat, reach Infinity 2, and establish Infinity progress in three different regions.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Infinity progression

MT13 → MT14: Expand Infinity across the map

Reach Infinity 5 and build Infinity records in ten distinct regions.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Infinity progression

MT14 → MT15: Complete the map and unlock the stones

Work toward Infinity 25, Infinity in all 15 regions, and the stone-related discovery needed for MT15.

Read walkthrough →Military tiers / Infinity progression

MT15: Prepare for the final boss and endgame

Use your completed military progression to prepare for Thorus and improve the systems supporting repeated endgame runs.
